items.source: 原创阅读 · The Old Bike（记叙文 · 亲情与成长） · 第1/5题
items.subject: english
items.stem: 第 1 题（细节理解）：Where did the writer find the old bike at first?
items.passage:
Last Saturday, I found an old bike in the corner of our garage. It was covered with dust and its paint had faded. I almost walked away, but something made me stop. It was the bike my father used to ride to work twenty years ago.

I cleaned it carefully and took it to a small shop nearby. The owner, an old man with grey hair, looked at it for a long time. "This is a Forever bike," he said. "People once waited months to buy one." He repaired the wheels and polished the frame for only fifty yuan.

When I rode it home, I felt something I had never felt before. The bike was slow and the bell was loud, but every turn seemed to tell a story. My father saw it and smiled. "I bought it with my first month's salary," he said. That evening he told me about the long rides to the factory, about the rain and the cold winter mornings.

Now the bike stands in our living room, not in the garage. It is too old to ride every day, but to my father it is the most valuable thing in our home.

options.option_analysis: 不选「In a small repair shop」：修理店是后来才去的地方，不是最初发现自行车的地方

options.text: In the corner of the garage
options.option_analysis: 正确。对应首句「in the corner of our garage」，正确
不选「On the street near home」：文中未说在街上发现
不选「In the factory」：factory 只出现在父亲骑车的回忆里

解析：定位第一段首句：old bike 在自家车库角落（in the corner of our garage）。

items.source: 原创阅读 · Why Sleep Matters（说明文 · 健康与科学） · 第1/5题
items.subject: english
items.stem: 第 1 题（细节理解）：How many hours of sleep do teenagers need every night according to scientists?
items.passage:
Sleep is not a waste of time. While you are asleep, your body is still working hard. It repairs tired muscles, fights off illness and stores what you learned during the day. Scientists say that teenagers need about eight to ten hours of sleep every night.

But many students get far less. Staying up late with phones or homework has become common. Research shows that less sleep can make it harder to pay attention in class, slow down your reactions and even change your mood. Students who sleep well usually remember new words better and do well in sports.

So how can you sleep better? First, keep a regular bedtime, even on weekends. Second, put away your phone at least half an hour before bed — the bright screen tells your brain that it is still daytime. Third, keep your room cool and quiet. Small changes can make a big difference.

Remember, sleep is not the enemy of hard work. It is part of it.

options.option_analysis: 不选「About five to six hours」：数字与原文不符
正确。对应第一段末句 eight to ten hours，正确
不选「About twelve hours」：数字偏大，文中未提
不选「As many as possible」：文中给的是明确区间，不是越多越好

items.formula_ref: 阅读理解 = 先看题干定位 → 回原文找依据 → 细节比对 / 逻辑推理 / 概括主旨
items.reference_answer:
标答：B. About eight to ten hours
解析：第一段末句：teenagers need about eight to ten hours of sleep every night。

items.source: 原创阅读 · Should Students Use Phones at School?（议论文 · 校园与规则） · 第1/5题
items.subject: english
items.stem: 第 1 题（细节理解）：What is one reason some students support using phones at school?
items.passage:
More and more students bring smartphones to school. Should they be allowed to use them in class? People hold different views.

Some students think phones help them learn. They can look up new words, take photos of key points and check information quickly. When a problem is hard, a phone can be a useful tool.

Others, however, worry that phones cause trouble. Games and short videos can easily draw students' attention away from lessons. Chatting in class may disturb both the user and classmates. Worse still, some students compare phones and feel unhappy about what they own.

In my opinion, the key is self-control, not the phone itself. Schools can set clear rules: keep phones silent during class and use them only for learning with a teacher's permission. If students can manage themselves, phones can stay; if not, they should be kept at home. Technology is neither good nor bad — it depends on how we use it.

options.text: They can play games between classes
options.option_analysis: 不选「They can play games between classes」：游戏是反对者担心的问题，不是支持理由

options.text: They can look up new words and check information
options.option_analysis: 正确。第二段列举了查单词、拍重点、查资料等学习用途

options.text: They can compare phones with classmates
options.option_analysis: 不选「They can compare phones with classmates」：这是反对者提到的负面现象

options.text: They can chat freely in class
options.option_analysis: 不选「They can chat freely in class」：课堂聊天是作者反对的行为

解析：第二段：look up new words, take photos of key points and check information。

If students can manage themselves, phones can stay; if not, they should be kept at home. Technology is neither good nor bad — it depends on how we use it.

items.passage:
More and more students bring smartphones to school. Should they be allowed to use them in class? People hold different views.

Some students think phones help them learn. They can look up new words, take photos of key points and check information quickly. When a problem is hard, a phone can be a useful tool.

Others, however, worry that phones cause trouble. Games and short videos can easily draw students' attention away from lessons. Chatting in class may disturb both the user and classmates. Worse still, some students compare phones and feel unhappy about what they own.

In my opinion, the key is self-control, not the phone itself. Schools can set clear rules: keep phones silent during class and use them only for learning with a teacher's permission. If students can manage themselves, phones can stay; if not, they should be kept at home. Technology is neither good nor bad — it depends on how we use it.

items.passage:
Lisa is my new classmate. She came to our school last month from Canada. At first, she was very quiet. She sat alone and did not talk much. I wanted to help her feel at home.

One day, I brought some Chinese cookies to school and gave her one. She smiled and said "thank you" in Chinese. Then she told me she loved our school lunch, especially the dumplings. We started to eat together every day.

Lisa is good at drawing. She drew a small picture of our classroom and gave it to me. In the picture, everyone is smiling. I was surprised because I never thought she watched us so carefully. Now we are best friends. She teaches me English and I teach her Chinese.

I learn one thing from Lisa: a friend is someone who shares your cookies and sees the smile on your face.

options.option_analysis: 正确。首段 from Canada，正确
不选「China」：中国是作者所在的地方，不是 Lisa 的来源
不选「England」：文中未提
不选「Australia」：文中未提

It was a hot summer day. A crow was very thirsty. He flew everywhere to find water, but he could not find any. At last, he saw a bottle under a tree. There was a little water in it.

The crow was happy, but then he had a problem. The bottle was tall and his beak could not reach the water. He thought and thought. He saw some small stones on the ground.

Suddenly, he had an idea. He picked up the stones one by one and put them into the bottle. Slowly, the water came up. At last, the crow could reach the water and drank it.

This story tells us that we should never give up. When we have a problem, we should think carefully and try different ways. Even a small, clever step can help us win.

items.stem: 第 4 题（词义猜测）：The phrase "give up" in the last paragraph means "___".
items.passage:
It was a hot summer day. A crow was very thirsty. He flew everywhere to find water, but he could not find any. At last, he saw a bottle under a tree. There was a little water in it.

The crow was happy, but then he had a problem. The bottle was tall and his beak could not reach the water. He thought and thought. He saw some small stones on the ground.

Suddenly, he had an idea. He picked up the stones one by one and put them into the bottle. Slowly, the water came up. At last, the crow could reach the water and drank it.

This story tells us that we should never give up. When we have a problem, we should think carefully and try different ways. Even a small, clever step can help us win.

options.option_analysis: 不选「尝试」：与 never 搭配和全文主旨不符
正确。never give up 是「永不放弃」，符合故事寓意
不选「成功」：语义不通
不选「休息」：与语境无关

items.formula_ref: 阅读理解 = 先看题干定位 → 回原文找依据 → 细节比对 / 逻辑推理 / 概括主旨
items.reference_answer:
标答：B. 放弃
解析：由结尾寓意「遇到问题要多想办法」可知 give up 是「放弃」。

options.option_analysis: 不选「Crows like drinking water」：只是故事表层

options.text: Never give up and think of clever ways
options.option_analysis: 正确。末段明确点出寓意
不选「Stones are useful」：石头是方法，不是道理
不选「Summer is hot」：天气只是背景
